info.title: OSPI Platform API
info.description: OSPI (Open Standard Product Identification) core platform. MVP scope per Project Constitution §43: Identity, Organizations, Auth, Producer Codes, OSPI Codes, Products, Variants, Categories, Attributes, Classification, Documents, Audit.

message.example: Validation failed for one or more fields.

requestId.description: Correlates this error with server-side logs.

password.description: At least 8 characters, plus one lowercase, one uppercase, one digit, and one symbol.

organizationId.description: Which organization to log into, if you belong to more than one. Defaults to your oldest active membership.

entityId.description: Which Entity (subsidiary) within the resolved organization to log into. Defaults to your oldest active EntityMembership there, or omitted entirely if you have none (plain organization-level access, unchanged).

totpCode.description: Required if the account has MFA enabled: either a 6-digit TOTP code from an authenticator app, or one single-use backup code (format XXXXX-XXXXX). Omitted/missing on an MFA-enabled account returns 401 MFA_REQUIRED rather than issuing tokens.

entityId.description: Target Entity within your CURRENT organization. Omit to clear the active entity and return to plain organization-level access.

scopes.description: Real, enforced permission codes — see src/auth/permissions.ts. '*' grants full org-wide access, same as the Owner role.

code.description: The 6-digit code currently shown by the authenticator app the enrollment QR/secret was added to.

password.description: Re-entering the account password is required to disable MFA, so a hijacked access token alone cannot turn off the account's second factor.

permissions.description: Real, enforced permission codes — see src/auth/permissions.ts. Use ['*'] via the default Owner role, not here, for full access.

resourceType.description: Scopes this role to a single Category or Location instead of the whole organization. Requires resourceId. Only meaningfully enforced for the one permission each type covers (CATEGORY -> products:write, LOCATION -> inventory:write) — see src/auth/scope.util.ts.

resourceId.description: The Category or Location id this role is scoped to. Required if resourceType is set.

whereToFindEnabled.description: Deel 16 §44-45 — opt in before this org's Offers can appear in "Where to Find" results.

discoverable.description: Deel 15 §26 — set false to stay hidden from partner-search (direct invitations still work).

ecosystemRoles.description: Deel 15 §7 — an org may hold multiple roles at once.

defaultUnitSystem.description: The stored baseline for MEASUREMENT display conversion, overridable per Entity or per-request (?unitSystem=).

commissionRatePercent.description: Percent, e.g. 0.5 for 0.5%. Pass null to clear the override and revert to the platform default (PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COMMISSION_RATE_PERCENT).

roleIds.description: Role IDs to assign — at least one is required.

billingAddress.description: Free-form billing address — matches the existing convention Order.shippingAddress already uses.

defaultUnitSystem.description: Overrides the organization's defaultUnitSystem for this legal entity. Omit to inherit the org default.

code.description: Desired producer code, A-Z0-9, max 12 characters

reserved.description: Reserve this identity (, Deel 4 §37) instead of registering it outright — useful for ERP sync/bulk imports/manufacturing workflows that need to hold a code before the product is fully created. Attaching it to a Product/Variant later still works directly — it does not need a separate "un-reserve" step first — and moves it straight to ACTIVE.

publicationState.description: Audience dimension, independent of `status` (, Deel 7 §68-69). Not yet wired into any cross-org visibility check — consequences.

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency (, Deel 22 §110-111). Optional — omit for the previous last-write-wins behavior; supply the version you last read to get a real 409 VERSION_CONFLICT if someone else updated the product first.

identity.description: Segments to mint a distinct OSPI identity (own full code) for this variant. Every variant now requires its own identity (product owner decision, amendment, 2026-08-17) — provide either this or ospiIdentityId, exactly one, not neither.

ospiIdentityId.description: An already-issued, unattached OSPI identity ID for this variant. Provide either this or `identity`, exactly one.

variantId.description: Optional — registers the unit under a specific variant rather than the base product.

serialBatch.description: The real per-unit/per-batch value (Deel 4 segment [EEEEEEEE]) — not the "00000000" placeholder.

note.description: Free text — required for NOTE/REPAIR, optional otherwise.

location.description: Where the unit is now — required for LOCATION_UPDATE.

custodian.description: Who now holds the unit — required for CUSTODY_TRANSFER.

toStatus.description: Required for STATUS_CHANGE — the unit's new status.

visibility.description: Default PRIVATE (Deel 7 §42) — an internal/ERP relationship is not automatically public.

percentage.description: Share of the parent product's composition, 0 < percentage <= 100.

changeTypes.description: Free-form tags describing what changed, e.g. "attributes", "documents".

effectiveDate.description: ISO 8601. Omit or set to now/past for an immediately-CURRENT version; a future date makes it SCHEDULED instead.

apiExportEnabled.description: Whether a new SerializedUnit may be minted against this specific frozen version.

brandingProfileId.description: One of the caller's own organization's BrandingProfile ids, or null to clear.

scope.description: 'organization' (default): private to your org, usable immediately, no review. 'global': a PROPOSAL for the shared cross-org registry — created PENDING, only usable once a `categories:govern` holder approves it via POST /categories/:id/approve.

unitCode.description: Default entry unit code, used when dataType = MEASUREMENT. Must resolve to a real Unit within unitCategoryId.

unitCategoryId.description: Which UnitCategory this MEASUREMENT attribute is a quantity of (e.g. LENGTH, MASS) — required when dataType = MEASUREMENT.

aggregatable.description: Opt in to DPP composition aggregation (a component's value is scaled by its BOM percentage and summed into the parent product's composed DPP). Allowed for dataType = DECIMAL, or MEASUREMENT with unitCategoryId set ( — component values are converted to the category's canonical unit before summing, so mismatched units never get silently added together).

value.description: Value shape depends on the attribute's dataType

sourceOrganizationId.description: Which organization supplied this value (field-level federation, Deel 11 §75). Defaults to the caller's own organization.

sourceReference.description: A document id/URL/system name to look up more detail — e.g. a certificate or ERP record.

conditionOnAttributeDefinitionId.description: Deel 11 §32: this rule only applies when the product's value for this OTHER attribute equals conditionOnValue.

reason.description: Why this attribute requirement is being proposed.

code.description: e.g. "M", "FT", "KG" — globally unique across all categories

system.description: Omit for a universal/scientific unit (e.g. Kelvin) valid under any display system.

toBaseOffset.description: For affine conversions (e.g. Celsius/Fahrenheit). Defaults to 0.

isCanonical.description: Exactly one canonical unit is allowed per category — the category's base unit.

isSystemDefault.description: Exactly one default is allowed per (category, system) pair — the unit resolveDisplayUnit picks for that system. Requires `system` to be set.

certificateMetadata.description: Deel 13 §27-28 — {certificateNumber?, issuer?, issuerOrganizationId?, issuedAt?, scope?}. Only meaningful when documentType is CERTIFICATE.

storageRef.description: Opaque reference to the actual file in object storage.

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex, if known — this endpoint has no bytes to compute one from itself.

certificateMetadata.description: Deel 13 §27-28 — {certificateNumber?, issuer?, issuerOrganizationId?, issuedAt?, scope?}. Only meaningful when documentType is CERTIFICATE.

filename.description: Original filename — used only to derive a file extension; never used as the on-disk name.

entityId.description: The Entity (subsidiary) this Location belongs to. Must belong to the caller's own organization.

capabilities.description: Capabilities requested (Deel 15 §10). Each side authorizes independently.

attributeCode.description: Code of an AttributeDefinition visible to your organization (global or your own).

value.description: Value to compare against. Must be an array when operator is "in".

connectionId.description: Must be an ACTIVE Connection the caller's organization is part of

targetId.description: productId or categoryId, depending on targetType. Omit for ALL_PRODUCTS.

ruleFilter.description: Rule-based/dynamic scoping, e.g. [{ attributeCode: "region", operator: "eq", value: "EU" }]. ANDed with each other and with targetType — a product must also match every rule to be in scope. Omit for no extra filtering.

variantId.description: Prices a specific variant instead of the base product — e.g. different sizes/colors with different prices. Never a serial/batch: pricing is always at product/variant (SKU) level, never per physical unit.

minimumQuantity.description: Decimal, not just whole units (, Deel 17 §29) — e.g. 4.5 kg.

locationId.description: Must be one of your own organization's Locations.

whereToFindVisible.description: Deel 16 §46 product-level opt-out — set false to exclude this specific offer from Where to Find even if your org is enabled.

minimumQuantity.description: Overrides Offer.minimumQuantity for this buyer only. Decimal (, Deel 17 §29).

billToEntityId.description: Bill this order to a specific Entity (subsidiary) of your organization. Defaults to your active Entity, if any; omit entirely for plain organization-level orders.

shipToEntityId.description: Ship this order to a specific Entity (subsidiary) of your organization. Defaults to your active Entity, if any.

quantity.description: Decimal, not just whole units (, Deel 17 §29) — e.g. 4.5 kg, 10.75 m.

expiresAt.description: Deel 17 §77 — an ISSUED quote past this is treated as EXPIRED.

requiredAttributeCodes.description: AttributeDefinition codes required for VALID status

variantId.description: Propose against a specific variant instead of the base product.

proposedValue.description: Value shape depends on the attribute's dataType.

reason.example: Product dimensions appear incorrect — measured 12kg, listing shows 10kg.

enabled.description: Defaults to false — configure first, enable once verified.

allowedDomains.description: Every entry must have a currently-VERIFIED DomainVerification row owned by this organization (see POST .../domain-verifications).

defaultRoleIds.description: Role IDs granted to a JIT-provisioned first-time SSO login — at least one is required, same reasoning as InviteUserDto.roleIds.

oidcIssuerUrl.description: Required when protocol=OIDC. The IdP's issuer URL, e.g. https://accounts.example-idp.com — must be https:// except for a loopback host (local testing only).

oidcClientSecret.description: Required when protocol=OIDC. Shown once in the create response, never re-served on subsequent reads (matches WebhookSubscription.secret's convention).

samlEntryPoint.description: Required when protocol=SAML. The IdP's SSO (redirect-binding) URL.

samlIssuer.description: Required when protocol=SAML. The IdP's entityID.

samlIdpCertificate.description: Required when protocol=SAML. The IdP's PEM-encoded public signing certificate — public material, not a secret.

postLoginRedirectUrl.description: Optional. When set, a successful SSO login 302s here with tokens in the URL fragment instead of returning raw JSON.

isDefault.description: Make this the org's default profile (unsets any previous default).
